title: LearnUpEventEnvelope
description: Canonical envelope schema for all domain events published to Apache Kafka across the LearnUP platform.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (used for deduplication and tracing).

eventType.description: PascalCase name of the domain event (e.g., CourseCompleted, RequiredAssignmentCreated).

version.description: Schema version of this event type, starting from 1.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the domain event occurred.

organizationId.description: Canonical organization/tenant identifier for multi-tenant scoping.

producer.description: Identifier of the publishing microservice (e.g., learning-service, assessment-service).
